items.title: Marina Horizon 2-Bedroom Apartment
items.summary: A bright two-bedroom apartment on a high floor with full marina views, a wraparound balcony and access to the tower pool, gym and covered parking.
items.description: This two-bedroom residence sits on a high floor of a well-managed Dubai Marina tower, a short walk from Marina Walk and the tram. The living area opens onto a wraparound balcony with uninterrupted marina views, and the kitchen is fully fitted with integrated appliances. Both bedrooms are en-suite, with the master offering built-in wardrobes and water views. The building includes a temperature-controlled pool, a modern gym, 24-hour security and one allocated parking bay. Well suited to professionals or a small family who want to be at the centre of the Marina lifestyle.

items.title: Palm Signature Garden Villa
items.summary: A five-bedroom garden villa on the fronds of Palm Jumeirah with a private pool, direct beach access and generous indoor-outdoor living space.
items.description: Positioned on one of the Palm's quieter fronds, this five-bedroom villa is built around indoor-outdoor living: a double-height entrance, formal and family living rooms, and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens onto the garden, private pool and beach. The ground floor includes a guest suite and a maid's room, while the upper floor hosts four en-suite bedrooms, including a master with a sea-facing terrace. Sold unfurnished, giving the next owner a clean canvas for their own interior direction. Viewings can be arranged with reasonable notice.

items.title: Downtown Skyline 1-Bedroom Apartment
items.summary: A furnished one-bedroom apartment minutes from Dubai Mall, with partial Burj Khalifa views and strong short-term and long-term rental appeal.
items.description: This one-bedroom apartment sits in an established Downtown tower within walking distance of Dubai Mall and the Opera District. It is sold fully furnished with a neutral, contemporary interior, making it equally suitable as a first home, a pied-à-terre or an income-generating unit. The living room and bedroom both enjoy partial Burj Khalifa views, and residents have access to a pool deck, gym and residents' lounge. Service charges and rental history can be shared on request.

items.title: Emirates Living Family Townhouse
items.summary: A three-bedroom lake-facing townhouse in The Springs with a private garden, upgraded kitchen and access to community pools and parks.
items.description: A well-kept three-bedroom townhouse in one of Dubai's most established family communities. The ground floor offers an open living and dining space, an upgraded kitchen and a private landscaped garden backing onto the lake path. Upstairs are three bedrooms and a family study nook. Residents enjoy community pools, parks, tennis courts and easy access to schools, supermarkets and Sheikh Zayed Road. Available for a 12-month lease, with flexible cheque options for qualified tenants.

items.title: Business Bay Canal-View Office Suite
items.summary: A fitted canal-view office suite in Business Bay with two meeting rooms, a reception area and capacity for around 25 workstations.
items.description: This fitted office suite occupies a corner position in a Grade A Business Bay tower with direct canal views. The layout includes a reception area, two glass-partitioned meeting rooms, a manager's office, a pantry and open space for roughly 25 workstations. The building offers visitor parking, high-speed lifts and 24-hour access — a practical base for a growing company that wants a central address between Downtown and Sheikh Zayed Road. DEWA and chiller are separate; full terms shared on enquiry.

items.title: JVC Garden 3-Bedroom Townhouse
items.summary: A corner three-bedroom townhouse in JVC with a wraparound garden, rooftop terrace and a practical layout for growing families.
items.description: A corner-plot townhouse in Jumeirah Village Circle offering more garden space than typical mid-unit layouts. Inside, the ground floor features an open kitchen and living area with garden access, while the first floor holds three bedrooms, including a master with a private balcony. A rooftop terrace adds flexible outdoor space for evening gatherings. JVC's parks, nurseries and retail centres are within a short drive, and both Al Khail Road and Hessa Street are easily reached. A sensible entry point into Dubai townhouse ownership.

items.title: Al Reem Island Waterfront 2-Bedroom
items.summary: A waterfront two-bedroom apartment on Al Reem Island with mangrove views, a large balcony and full community amenities.
items.description: Set in a waterfront tower on Al Reem Island, this two-bedroom apartment looks out over the mangroves and canal from a generous balcony. The interior offers a semi-furnished, move-in-ready finish with an open kitchen, en-suite master bedroom and dedicated laundry space. Building amenities include an infinity pool, gym, children's play area and direct boardwalk access. Al Reem's schools, supermarkets and healthcare options are all within minutes, with downtown Abu Dhabi a short drive away.

items.title: Arjan Modern Studio Apartment
items.summary: A smartly furnished studio in Arjan near Miracle Garden — an efficient layout with pool, gym and easy access to Umm Suqeim Street.
items.description: An efficient, fully furnished studio in a newer Arjan building close to Dubai Miracle Garden. The layout separates the sleeping area from a compact living zone, with a fitted kitchenette and a balcony overlooking the community. The building includes a rooftop pool, gym and covered parking. With quick connections to Umm Suqeim Street and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, it suits single professionals who want value without giving up quality. One cheque and multiple cheque options considered.

items.title: Dubai Hills Park-Edge 4-Bedroom Villa
items.summary: A four-bedroom villa steps from Dubai Hills Park, with a landscaped garden, open family kitchen and quick access to Dubai Hills Mall.
items.description: This four-bedroom villa sits on a quiet street a short walk from Dubai Hills Park. The ground floor combines a formal living room with a large family kitchen that opens onto the landscaped garden, plus a guest bedroom and maid's room. Upstairs, three further bedrooms include a spacious master suite with a walk-in wardrobe. The community offers cycling tracks, schools, Dubai Hills Mall and the golf course, with Downtown roughly 15 minutes away. Available for immediate handover to a qualified tenant.

items.title: Sharjah Muwaileh 2-Bedroom Apartment
items.summary: A well-priced two-bedroom apartment in a family-focused Muwaileh community, close to universities, schools and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.
items.description: Located in one of Sharjah's fastest-growing family districts, this two-bedroom apartment offers practical space at a sensible price point. The unit features an open living and dining area, a closed kitchen and two well-sized bedrooms with built-in wardrobes. The community includes landscaped courtyards, a pool, a gym and retail on the ground level, with University City and several schools nearby. An attractive option for end users and investors targeting Sharjah's steady rental demand.
